name: 50/30/20 rule
watch: Needs can be more than 50% if rent is high.

name: Envelope method
how: Put a fixed amount for each category in separate envelopes or bank accounts.
good: You can see exactly when a category is empty.
watch: Needs discipline not to move money between envelopes.

name: Zero-based budget
how: Give every dong a job so income minus plans equals zero.
watch: Takes time to plan every month.

name: Pay yourself first
how: Save a fixed % the day money arrives, spend the rest freely.
watch: You still need to track spending to avoid running out.
